meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把大目标拆成细小的、有证据可查的步骤,用专用命令行工具记录进度,每完成一步都要求提供真实可验证的产出,并自动委派子代理处理代码等任务。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ulw-loop”“ulw”等触发词,或提出需要长期执行、带证据检查的目标时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我拆解并执行这个目标,每步都要留证据。
say.note: 启动目标循环,开始记录和验证。

say.text: 把当前任务细分成原子步骤,并更新计划清单。
用证据导向模式完成这个功能,并做手动 QA。
say.note: 触发完整工作流和 QA 渠道。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude decomposes large goals into small, evidence-bound steps, tracks progress in a dedicated CLI, requires observable evidence for each success criterion, and delegates code work to subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop' or 'ulw', or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break down and execute this goal, keeping evidence at each step.
Split the current task into atomic steps and update the plan checklist.
Complete this feature in evidence-led mode and run manual QA.
